name: Doumeki Ichiru
source:
Gaming Former Delinquent

An ex-delinquent gang leader who now aspires to become a pro gamer.
She skips school and practices gaming nonstop, idolizing streamers.
This shut-in bad girl works part-time at a convenience store
aiming to buy gaming gadgets.
